_comment: Approval status of the fixed replies and page text (chatbot/fixed.py lists their exact words). There is no fallback for these, so a --public build (npm run deploy:public) refuses to run until every one is approved: `status` "approved by NAME YYYY-MM-DD" and `reviewed` (a hash of the exact words, written by signoff_doc.py --apply; an edit after approval un-approves it).
